notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/302a288b797653860b197e400dc7dda594a8064b.png[/img]
Thank you for playing Manafinder! It's been a wonderful year, and I'm incredibly grateful for all of your support!

Manafinder's (first) anniversary is actually next week, but the weeklong celebrations have already started! 

First of all, the game will continue to enjoy a 33% discount until October 4th, 2023 10:00am PDT.

Secondly, Manafinder has been updated with an in-game "Anniversary Gallery" where you can browse concept art as well as special art, including the beautiful anniversary art made by Angel Cervantes. The "Anniversary Gallery" can also be viewed from the official website with some extra liner notes.

Stay tuned on our social media for other very special announcements in the following days! :)

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/63d60cb178725b806c639572b05189a6cdec3b00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/6fa269963d140e86d7442177aa0dac83ee1160d8.png[/img]
[h2]Anniversary Gallery[/h2]
[list]
[*] You may access the "Anniversary Gallery" in the Northern Lake overlook located in the northwest corner of The Settlement. The gallery is unlocked after having climbed the steps right after camping in the Emerald Peak.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing F12 key would open the Developer Console.
[/list]

notes.title: Manafinder is now available on Mac OS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a little over two months since the release of Manafinder, and I am very grateful for all the positive reception so far! 

Today, I am happy to announce that Manafinder is now available on Mac OS! Thank you so much for your patience! There is also a discount this week as part of the Turn Based Fest... just in time for the holiday season!

Please keep reporting any issues on this thread, and please keep enjoying Manafinder! And from now on, please let me know which OS you are playing Manafinder on when reporting bugs :)
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3361398165646911469/

[h1]What about Linux?[/h1]
I was made aware the game is already a 100% playable using Proton. [b]This includes the game being a 100% playable on Steam Deck[/b]!

At this point I don't really see the value of doing a native Linux build, but if you really think there is one please comment below!

notes.title: "New Game++" has been added! (and other fixes)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a little over a month since the release of Manafinder, and I am incredibly grateful for all the positive reception so far! Thank you all so much for playing! 

I've released a fourth patch (v 1.04) that addresses a few issues, but most importantly it introduces a new "New Game Plus" mode called "[b]New Game++[/b]"! Read the patch notes below for more information.

Please keep reporting any issues on this thread, and please keep enjoying Manafinder!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3361398165646911469/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3361398165646911469/[/url]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Game++[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Game++[/b] has been added as an option after you clear the game. In this mode you will retain everything on your new game except your key items (including Heavenstones and Manashards), komaleaves, ores, spears, and the Counterattack magic. 
[*] The old [b]New Game+[/b] mode is also still an option. While I assume the New Game++ will be more popular (based on player feedback), I did not want to take away existing options.
[*] If you have an existing save file right after finishing the game (Clear Data), you will be able to select both New Game Plus modes. (see pictures below)
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] A helpful hint reminding you to check your equipment for [i]Light [/i]elemental vulnerability has been added whenever you are K.O.'d in the final area of Chapter 4.
[*] The hint provided when you are defeated by the boss Mount Olov has been updated to be even more informative. 
[*] Additional autosave triggers were added in the final area of Chapter 4.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a couple of Unleash attacks, such as Meteor Rain, would cause a display bug in the final boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where a couple of texts were missing Spanish translation.
[*] Fixed a couple of spelling and grammar errors. (Spanish)
[/list]

[h1]Other Announcements[/h1]
The native Linux port is coming along nicely! If all goes well it should be released before November ends. Work on Mac port will commence after the Linux port is released.

[h1]About the Weapons Galore achievement in New Game++[/h1]
Please note that while in New Game++ your weapons are carried over and do count towards the achievement, you will still need to have [b]all[/b] of the weapons in your inventory, including the spear updates which are not carried over.

[h1]Accessing New Game++ on an existing clear data save[/h1]
If you have an existing save file right after finishing the game (Clear Data) prior to the installation of this patch, you will still be able to select both New Game Plus modes. At first you won't see the option, but simply select New Game+...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/548402045f6c8ec7b00550e148db3ddd2794b574.png[/img]

And you will get a message explaining that new options were added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/71e3ab2ea37b215a37a39893376aa954920cc3d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/be947c70b51dd1db0327e14aade37d84310a8703.png[/img]

notes.title: Manafinder's launch discount ends tomorrow, upcoming patch, and other news!
notes.content:
First of al I would like to thank you all for your support! Thanks for all your kind words, sharing your playthroughs, impressions, reviews, etc. I'm loving them! 

There are a couple of news I would like to share with all of you.

[h1]Launch Discount Ending Tomorrow[/h1]
The launch discount will be ending tomorrow at 10:00am PDT.

[h1]Upcoming Patch[/h1]
Please keep reporting bugs and issues here! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3361398165646911469/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3361398165646911469/[/url]

I am preparing a patch that will address the reported issues, plus a few other issues I've been made aware of. I'm really sorry to all of you that ran into a bug, and I hope that none was severe enough to dampen your experience.

I will try to release the patch later this week, or early next week (depending on how long it takes to me to squash the bugs).

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
I am in the process of getting the soundtrack approved for sale here on Steam! It unfortunately takes some time to go through the approval process, so it probably won't be up for sale here until next week.

In the meantime you can listen to (and obtain) the soundtrack at [url=https://calamarespaciales.bandcamp.com/album/manafinder-official-ost]Calamrespaciales's bandcamp[/url]! (That is Manafinder's composer official bandcamp btw).

[h1]Steam Deck Support[/h1]
Based on the demo, and what players have been telling me... Manafinder is compatible with the Steam Deck! :)

As of today there is no way to formally request Valve to review a game for official information about Steam Deck support, so I don't know how long it will take them to display the game as Deck Verified.

[h1]Mac and Linux Support[/h1]
I will be looking into this later this year. Right now my priority is fixing bugs! But I hear you! I will announce it once it's official and I have more details about this. I just wanted you to know that I have not forgotten about this.

I really hope you keep enjoying Manafinder! And once again, thank you so much for playing!

notes.title: Steam demo deactivation on 09/28
notes.content:
[b]Manafinder [/b] will be released this October 5 2022, which also means that the time has finally come to delist the demo from Steam. Said deactivation will happen this week on 09/28. I've prepared an FAQ to answer any potential questions and concerns you may have about this. Also, feel free to drop a comment below so I can answer any additional question you may have! 

[h2]Why now, so near the release date?[/h2]
I've been meaning to deactivate it earlier, however the demo was a great way to showcase the game on a couple of events, such as the Seattle Indies Expo 2022 which just happened on 09/24: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/six2022 

That unfortunately left a very small window between said events and actual release.

[h2]Why not leave the demo up?[/h2]
The demo and final build have diverged significantly since January/February 2022. While at a first glance they make look very similar, "behind the scenes" there have been some changes. But most importantly, see the question below about the save file.

[h2]Can I transfer my save file to the full release?[/h2]
Short answer: No, at least I don't recommend it for two reasons:
1. You will miss some Steam achievements activation.
2. Save file may cause some bugs further down the line, specially if your save file is from the earlier releases (2021) of the demo.

I understand this is not ideal, and I apologize for this in advance. I'm happy to hear your comments here, and if this is a very contentious point I will definitely try to the best of my abilities to provide alternatives such as perhaps providing a save file that leaves you near the end of the demo.

[h2]But I want to try out Manafinder before buying it![/h2]
If you really really insist on still trying the demo even after reading the warnings above, then know that I will leave the demo up on other non-storefront websites, such as rpgmaker.net

Alternatively, the demo was picked up by a couple of gamers that posted their playthroughs on YouTube! Example:
[previewyoutube=RGzIMh016PU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for understanding and supporting Manafinder. I really hope that you enjoy the final release! And remember, I am happy to hear you out below in case you have any concerns!

notes.title: Demo has been updated, Steam Deck support update, and other news!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've released a new demo update (patch notes below) but I also wanted to share a couple of other updates!

[olist]
[*]Manafinder is now in the beta-testing phase! I'm currently estimating a September/October release timeframe! I'll shout it from the rooftops once I have an official release date.
[*]Manafinder will launch with full English and Spanish language support!
[*]Japanese translation is also underway, but in its infancy at the moment. I'll be happy to share more about this in the future.  マナファインダ!
[*]ICYMI Manafinder was part of the INDIE Live Expo 2022 last week and is part of the ongoing Dreamhack Beyond this week!
[*]Thanks to Lula for confirming the Manafinder demo runs perfectly fine on Steam Deck!
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257046/ae795c0b5315288a695dd2b0506c4804b33f12fe.png[/img]

Lastly, here are the promised demo patch notes! 
[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an old lady NPC in The Settlement, next to The Settlement's Temple, that tells you the story about the Foundation of Manahill. Fun fact: This cutscene was the game's intro back in 2017, but it was then removed because it was a bit too heavy on the exposition. I love it so much, but I just couldn't find a place for it!
[*] Fixed a bug where Lambda would start with the wrong battler graphic in the Prologue.
[*] You can now [Pet Scar] through Dama's questline and the southeastern "Petting Point" in The Settlement.
[*] Added a hint in the Emerald Trail that explains how you may save your "Unleash" for another time.
[*] Some text was slightly updated.
[*] The settlers now have updated dialogue after you come back from your first mission. In the full release, settlers will update their dialogue as major events transpire.
[*] Updated a couple of Sound Effects to rely less on RTP assets. Nothing against RTP, just a personal style choice + would make the console port easier I guess?
[*] Added the "Font License" in the Title Screen. 
[*] The Emerald Trail tiles received a graphic overhaul to be more consistent with the rest of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo QoL (and other fixes) update released!
notes.content:
A demo update has been released that focuses on two new "Quality of Life" features: 'Faster Message Speed' and 'Battle Animation Speed'! Additionally, some graphical updates and bug fixes were made.

Remember to Wishlist Manafinder on Steam, and follow us on social media, and spread the word of the demo! It really makes a difference! Thank you for playing!
Social media links: https://linktr.ee/manafinder 

Also please continue to submit feedback on the official demo feedback thread!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3117034127808573846/

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]
[h3]Video version[/h3]
[previewyoutube=FqKdH_n6rZ0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Text version[/h3]

[list]
[*] New features and content:
[*] New Option: "Faster Message Speed" has been introduced. When enabled text speed will be displayed faster. (Default: OFF)
[*] New Option: "Battle Animation Speed" has been introduced. Toggle between Normal -> Fast -> Faster -> Fastest to accelerate battle animation speed. (Default: OFF)
[*] Signs have been added to points of interest in The Settlement.
[*] Added some Autosave triggers after a couple of lengthy dialogues.
[/list]

Visual Updates:
[list]
[*] New items, skills, magics, weapons, armors, etc. are now highlighted with a red dot icon.
[*] The cow, horse, and pig sprites have been updated. (Bye GIANT cows!)
[*] The message portrait of King Vikar has been updated with a scar in his right eye to be consistent with his cutscene version.
[*] Updated the rock sprites in the Emerald Trail. (thanks Virtua Sanus!)
[/list]

Grammar/Spelling errors:
[list]
[*] Fixed "commission" spelling when speaking with Mar and Sol in The Settlement. (thanks ShadowDragon!)
[*] Fixed the "Brace" magic description.
[*] Fixed the "Komabiscuit" item description.
[*] Fixed the "M.Atk" and "M.Def" related blessings name. (Previously they were named E.Atk and E.Def since both stats were going to be named Elemental Attack and Defense in the early stages of the game).
[*] Fixed "Critical Hit" spelling in multiple descriptions. (thanks Vorvek!)
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a small passability issue on a tree next to Joachim. (thanks ShadowDragon!)
[*] Fixed the walking animation of a settler. (Ear would blink on each frame). (thanks Doggy!)
[*] Fixed the healing effect of the Komabiscuit.
[*] Fixed a bug when speaking to the passed out settler in the temple's entrance from the side. (thanks Vorvek!)
[*] Fixed the moving route of a settler near the Settlement's bridge to avoid a collision bug. (thanks ShadowDragon!)
[*] Fixed a small visual bug when standing behind tents in The Settlement. (thanks ShadowDragon!)
[*] Moved a Zephyrac's position near a stone ladder in the Emerald Trail to avoid a graphical bug with Lambda.
[*] Fixed a minor scripting error.
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Save Points have been removed.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo performance (and other fixes) update released!
notes.content:
A demo update has been released that includes significant performance updates! Most importantly the lag some players have experienced on the level-up screen and The Settlement have been optimized. Additionally, a new option has been added under the General section to enable a "Performance Mode" which removes some effects to further optimize performance. 

Remember to Wishlist Manafinder on Steam, and follow us on social media, and spread the word of the demo! It really makes a difference! Thank you for playing!
Social media links: https://linktr.ee/manafinder 

Also please continue to submit feedback on the official demo feedback thread!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582410/discussions/0/3117034127808573846/ 

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]
New features and content:
[list]
[*]Flavor text has been added to the graves in The Settlement's graveyard.
[*]"Performance Mode" option has been added under the Options -> General section. Enabling it will boost performance in certain areas that use special weather effects such as The Settlement's clouds.
[*]The number of available save slots has been expanded from 6 to 30.
[*]A minor explanation of Spirit Dust has been added to the game's Prologue.
[*]Spirit Dust bar will now change color when leveling up.
[*]Additional dirt paths have been added to the Emerald Trail to make the path clearer to players.
[/list]

Grammar/Spelling errors:
[list]
[*]Fixed "Antidote Herb" spelling
[*]Fixed some of Father Nolwenn's dialogue
[*]Minor dialogue reduction when speaking to the Goddess Behra in the level-up screen.
[/list]

Performance optimizations:
[list]
[*]Overall performance boost by removing unused scripts.
[*]Optimized the Spirit Dust donation screen to avoid severe lag spikes.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a small visual bug on a tree in the Violet Hills
[*]Fixed a small visual bug on Joachim's head in the Emerald trailhead
[*]Fixed the "Autosave" timing when praying at the Sanctuary
[*]Fixed bug where Batho would disappear if you speak to him from the side
[*]Fixed Prisoner Lambda's running animation when facing downwards 
[*]Fixed Fast Travel options when skipping Prologue
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*]Added choice to open Manafinder LinkTree instead of forcefully opening it when completing the demo to make it less obtrusive
[*]Slightly adjusted the vertical positioning of the map name shown when entering a new area
[/list]
